definitions.gloss: manual labor at a temple; cleaning and maintenance work (in Zen Buddhism)
definitions.explanation: Originally a Zen Buddhist term for daily physical work considered part of spiritual practice.

examples.english: I swept the garden during the morning work session.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作務衣|さむえ}→作務衣：21339_samue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧{作務|さむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}りかかる。
examples.english: I put on work clothes and start the temple chores.

examples.japanese: {禅寺|ぜんでら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{作務|さむ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一環|いっかん}→一環：17696_ikkan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At Zen temples, manual labor is considered part of spiritual training.

notes:
A Zen Buddhist concept where daily physical labor — sweeping, cleaning, cooking, gardening — is regarded as a form of meditative practice equal in value to seated meditation (⟦{座禅|ざぜん}→座禅：09641_zazen⟧). The word is best known through the compound ⟦{作務衣|さむえ}→作務衣：21339_samue⟧, the simple work clothing worn during these tasks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{作務衣|さむえ}→作務衣：21339_samue⟧: work clothes (originally for temple work, now popular as casual wear)
- {作務|さむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do temple work
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作務|さむ}: morning work session

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{作務衣|さむえ}→作務衣：21339_samue⟧ has become popular as comfortable casual clothing beyond temple settings. Many craftspeople, artists, and restaurants use ⟦{作務衣|さむえ}→作務衣：21339_samue⟧ as work uniforms.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧: ascetic training, spiritual discipline — broader term for religious practice
- ⟦{座禅|ざぜん}→座禅：09641_zazen⟧: seated meditation — the contemplative counterpart to active {作務|さむ}
